sentence: You can swap your unwanted clothes with friends to save money.
synonym: exchange your unwanted clothes with friends
synonymNote: exchange表示互换物品，与swap含义完全相同

distractors.word: sell your unwanted clothes with friends
distractors.note: sell是出售赚钱，不是互换，意思不同

distractors.word: share your unwanted clothes with friends
distractors.note: share是共享或分享，不是互相交换

distractors.word: throw away your unwanted clothes with friends
distractors.note: throw away是丢弃，与互换意思相反
